name: @functions-oneui/onboarding-react
description: React and SPFx-friendly onboarding integration for OneUI.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-core run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-styles run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-core run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-styles run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-core run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-styles run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:ui: pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-core run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/onboarding-styles run build && pnpm --filter @functions-oneui/theme run build && vitest --config vitest.config.ts --ui
